basics.label: Systems Administrator | Windows Infrastructure, Troubleshooting & Automation
basics.summary: Systems administrator focused on root-cause troubleshooting across Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, RMM, and monitoring. projects.name: Custom Ticketing & POS Operations System
projects.description: The legacy Perl/PHP system still handled tickets, labor, pricing, parts, and custom-computer builds, but it had become impossible to update or repair and still ran as an IIS application on Windows Server 2008. I learned the workflow, then designed, built, and deployed its replacement from scratch in Python and JavaScript with Microsoft SQL Server and existing POS integration. It fully retired the old system while preserving full backward compatibility, so all existing data remained usable in the new system. I still own authentication, backups, updates, bug fixes, and feature development.
highlights: The legacy Perl/PHP system still supported the repair workflow but had become impossible to update or repair and still ran as an IIS application on Windows Server 2008.

projects.name: RMM Communication Failure Investigation
projects.description: At a Microworx customer, RMM agents were failing to check in, blocking patch management and managed antivirus. I wrote targeted diagnostic scripts, traced the failure across the endpoint and network path, and isolated a rogue RAID-monitoring process that was flooding TCP traffic and preventing normal RMM communication.
highlights: RMM check-ins were failing, which blocked patch management and managed antivirus functions.
Wrote targeted diagnostic scripts and traced the failure to a rogue RAID-monitoring process flooding TCP traffic.
Identified the hidden software conflict behind a failure that initially presented as an RMM communication problem.

projects.name: VSS Live-Imaging Workflow
projects.description: Commercial imaging software added recurring cost, and the existing deployment path could carry problems from the old Windows installation into the new system. I built an in-house VSS live-imaging and delta-merging workflow that moved programs and data onto a fresh Windows installation instead.
highlights: The existing imaging process slowed endpoint deployment and could carry operating-system corruption into the replacement system.
Developed an in-house VSS live-imaging and delta-merging workflow that restored programs and data onto a fresh Windows installation.
Improved deployment stability by avoiding corruption carried forward from the previous Windows installation.
